import java.io.*;

public class Variant1 {
    static class FastReader {
        private final InputStream stream;
        private final byte[] buffer = new byte[8192];
        private int curIndex, bufLen;

        public FastReader(InputStream st) {
            this.stream = st;
        }

        private int readByte() {
            if (bufLen == -1) throw new RuntimeException("Input mismatch");
            if (curIndex >= bufLen) {
                curIndex = 0;
                try {
                    bufLen = stream.read(buffer);
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    throw new RuntimeException(e);
                }
                if (bufLen <= 0) return -1;
            }
            return buffer[curIndex++];
        }

        public int nextInt() {
            int c = readByte();
            while (c <= ' ') c = readByte();
            int sign = 1;
            if (c == '-') {
                sign = -1;
                c = readByte();
            }
            int val = 0;
            do {
                val = val * 10 + c - '0';
                c = readByte();
            } while (c > ' ');
            return val * sign;
        }

        public long nextLong() {
            int c = readByte();
            while (c <= ' ') c = readByte();
            int sign = 1;
            if (c == '-') {
                sign = -1;
                c = readByte();
            }
            long val = 0;
            do {
                val = val * 10 + c - '0';
                c = readByte();
            } while (c > ' ');
            return val * sign;
        }

        public int[] nextIntArray(int n) {
            int[] arr = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) arr[i] = nextInt();
            return arr;
        }

        public String next() {
            int c = readByte();
            while (c <= ' ') c = readByte();
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            do {
                sb.append((char) c);
                c = readByte();
            } while (c > ' ');
            return sb.toString();
        }

        public String nextLine() {
            int c = readByte();
            while (c <= ' ') c = readByte();
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            do {
                sb.append((char) c);
                c = readByte();
            } while (c != '\n' && c != '\r' && c != -1);
            return sb.toString();
        }

        private boolean isWhitespace(int c) {
            return c <= ' ';
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        FastReader in = new FastReader(System.in);
        int n = in.nextInt();
        int budget = in.nextInt();
        int[] arr = in.nextIntArray(n);

        int[] oddPrefix = new int[n + 1];
        int[] evenPrefix = new int[n + 1];

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            if (arr[i - 1] % 2 == 1) {
                oddPrefix[i] = oddPrefix[i - 1] + 1;
                evenPrefix[i] = evenPrefix[i - 1];
            } else {
                oddPrefix[i] = oddPrefix[i - 1];
                evenPrefix[i] = evenPrefix[i - 1] + 1;
            }
        }

        int lastCut = 0;
        PriorityQueue<Integer> costs = new PriorityQueue<>();
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            int oddCount = oddPrefix[i] - oddPrefix[lastCut];
            int evenCount = evenPrefix[i] - evenPrefix[lastCut];
            if (oddCount == evenCount) {
                costs.add(Math.abs(arr[i] - arr[i - 1]));
                lastCut = i;
            }
        }

        int totalCost = 0;
        int cuts = 0;
        while (!costs.isEmpty() && totalCost <= budget) {
            totalCost += costs.peek();
            costs.poll();
            cuts++;
        }

        if (cuts == 0) {
            System.out.println(0);
        } else {
            if (costs.isEmpty() && totalCost <= budget) {
                System.out.println(cuts);
            } else {
                System.out.println(cuts - 1);
            }
        }
    }
